# Soumik Chatterjee

> AI Enablement Specialist. I work in three lanes, community and member support, AI workflows that teams run without me, and part-time AI training.

Soumik Chatterjee is open to a full-time role in community support, AI workflows or AI training, and to scoped contract work. Based in Kolkata, India. Available to start immediately.

## Results

- 9 automated B2B pipelines, 2,314 contacts and $1.47M CAD of prospect pipeline in 90 days, with an estimated 20-30 founder hours saved each month (Toronto founder)
- 30% less manual outreach across a 400+ person workforce in the US, UAE and India, with 90%+ client retention (CampK12)
- Python test automation frameworks for banking and healthcare clients, with post-deployment defects down 15% (Accenture)
- 14 live AI tools shipped solo, including two Chrome Web Store extensions with 300+ users between them
